reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Checkpoint-mutant epistasis/overexpression ordering followed by purified RAD9 DNA binding and reciprocal overexpression.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-experiment consultation/check of original Methods, supplements or validated protocols to select and transfer detailed conditions; establishing local prerequisites alone is insufficient.
The packet does not exclude additional RAD9 repair functions. External delay permitting repair is not proof that RAD9 is unrelated to repair.

The claim that 10,000 EMS colonies provide approximately threefold genome coverage, the expected 0.1-1% hit rate and analog-screen justification are unsupported supplied-source facts rather than labeled provisional design targets.

checks.quote: Treat WT cells with ethyl methanesulfonate
checks.reason: Several proposed assay numbers are useful, but the screen preparation/quantitative treatment-to-recovery workflow and construct/active-protein verification are not executable or resolved through a concrete calibrated procedure.

checks.quote: the same fragment irradiated at the calibrated dose
checks.reason: The heterogeneous irradiated DNA has variable lesion number/fragment length, without matched substrate integrity and nonspecific binding calibration. Active RAD9 protein/complex is not verified, so a negative EMSA cannot distinguish inactivity from absence of binding.

Large-budded morphology is treated as the checkpoint-specific G2/M state without required nuclear/DNA-content confirmation. The packet does not establish that stage; the final caveat does not repair the primary endpoint.
The >90% power assertion uses a binomial cell count and ignores unknown between-culture variance. Averaging technical counts does not justify this culture-level power claim.

checks.quote: Retain only mutants that reproducibly fail to arrest
checks.reason: Screen selection is legitimate, but confirmatory exclusions, failed measurements and denominators lack an outcome-independent policy. Discovery coverage is not a complete stopping/attrition plan for the main causal assays.

Tests of pooled cell proportions do not incorporate independently allocated culture variation; the later averaging statement does not specify a valid replicate-level proportion model. Bonferroni alone does not repair pseudoreplication.
Troubleshooting and pilot separation are present, but no explicit change-control policy requires re-freezing the revised procedure and fresh independent confirmation after technical changes.

checks.quote: These predictions are mutually exclusive and therefore diagnostic.
checks.reason: The principal recommendation is false: loss-of-function epistasis and RAD9 overexpression rescue/nonrescue do not uniquely order a saturated checkpoint pathway or distinguish sensor/transducer/effector. Sections 1.4 and 1.6 even reverse rescue direction. Absent binding also cannot uniquely reject sensing. Charge this one identifying defect once; apply the central-premise cap.
Raw movie/lineage/assay identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and source-to-output records sufficient to reconstruct the study are not specified as a complete audit trail.

A meaningful alternative sensor/transducer question and prospective sham/genetic/vector/temperature-independent controls are present. Genetic identity and biochemical feasibility are addressed. The assay principles and overall chain are explicit; the invalid diagnostic mapping is charged specifically to P13 rather than duplicated as G1/G3/G4. 3,300 words meet format.

central_false_premise: The prioritized rescue/epistasis experiment is asserted to uniquely distinguish RAD9 sensor versus transducer and order components, although the same outcomes occur in multiple network structures and rescue direction is internally reversed.
explanation_reason: The primary genetic-ordering logic is nonidentifying and internally contradictory. Useful controls and biochemical detail do not make those conclusions diagnostic; source-like coverage/power claims are also unsupported.
historical_match_reason: The primary question concerns repair-state versus timer control and temporal RAD9 requirement. It does not ask whether checkpoint initiation AND recovery require new protein synthesis, nor propose verified translation inhibition with corresponding drug controls and both switching readouts. These are scientifically legitimate alternative directions, but none of the five specific synthesis-versus-existing-protein historical components is supplied. Q2 is assessed separately.
